summary.en: After punk: bass-led rhythm, space in the mix, art-school arrangement.
summary.zh: 朋克之后：贝斯主导节奏、混音留白、艺术学院式编曲。

body.en: Post-Punk keeps Punk's edge while reintroducing atmosphere, prominent bass lines, and art-school experiment. It feeds Alternative and later Indie guitar scenes.
body.zh: 后朋克保留 Punk 的锋利，同时重新引入氛围、突出的贝斯线与艺术学院式实验。它影响 Alternative 与后来的 Indie 吉他场景。
